inputs.original_text: These Phoenix city leaders are at it again, pushing their schemes to undermine federal immigration enforcement and national authority. The city council voted Wednesday night to impose fresh restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement when it comes to using city property. This is the same resistance we've seen before, where these officials put open borders ahead of the rule of law and the protection of American families. Tying the hands of federal agents like this is just asking for more chaos at the border and weakens our fundamental responsibility to safeguard our sovereignty and cultural heritage. It's a glaring example of skewed priorities that favor activist posturing over maintaining traditional order.
inputs.modified_text: These Phoenix city leaders keep showing their true colors by scheming to block federal immigration enforcement and chip away at national authority. Just this Wednesday night the city council voted to slap new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement using city property. It's the same tired resistance pattern where they place open borders above the rule of law and the safety of American families. Handcuffing our federal agents this way only invites more border chaos while eroding our core duty to protect sovereignty and cultural heritage. This is classic progressive overreach that puts activist posturing ahead of personal responsibility, family security, and the traditional order that keeps our nation strong.
